page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries; running head "PE" centred at top; page number 534 top left; catchword "Penna]" at lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the background and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Pellucere] Perlucet villa crebrius quàm cribrum, Plaut. Interlucet corona rara viris. Potes per illum videre, Virg. Interpatet rimis pulmo, Macrob. Translucet gemma, Plin. Transpicitur aliquid, Lucr.
Pelluciditas] Perluciditas vitri, Vitr. Limpitudo, Plin.

Pellucidus] Pellucidulus lapillus, Catul. Translucens, Translucidus. Pertranslucida charta, Plin. Liquidus aër, Virg. Liquidiusculus, Plaut. Perspicuus, Mart. Pellucens amictus, Ovid. Perspicibilis splendor solis, Vitr. Limpidus lacus, Catul. Clarus, Ovid.
Pelvis] Aqualis, Varr. Concha ærea, Amm. Concha ferrea, Plin. Sinus aquarius, Non. Trulleum, Varr. Trullium, Cat. Pollubrum, Liv. Trulleus, Arnob. Pelluvium, Fest. Trua, Varr.
Pendere] Dependere collo. Suspendere, Col. Appensum esse, Cicer. Præpendere, Mart. Pendere ex, in arbore, ab humero, Cic. Pendere de, à, Virg.
Pendulus] Pensilis uva, Hor. Propenduli crines, Apul. Apta è lacertis brachia, Lucr.
Penetrabilis] Vibrans oratio, Cicer. Meabilis per omnia rerum spiritus, Plin. Manabile frigus, Lucr. Oxypora antidota, Plin.

Penetrare] Penetrare cœlum, per cœlum, in cœlum. Permeat & transit per omnia intelligentia. Vibrant fulmina. Tranat ignis, Cicer. Permanat ad ossa frigus. Travolat vitri species foramina. Traviat ignis aliquid, Lucr. Persidit ad vivum humor, Virg. Transabit costas ensis, Id.
Penetrare ad cor] In venis medullisque insidere. Aculeos in animos relinquere.

Penitus] Prorsùm, Ter. Prorsus. In omne tempus. Planè non intellexi ænigma. Planè benè. Omnino. Funditus interiere, Cic. In totum, Quint. Ex toto, Sen. Per omnia, Col. Absolutè, Gell. Abruptè, Macrob.

page.notes: Faint show-through of the facing page (entries from PE/PH columns) is visible in the background and was omitted. Doubtful: "Pelluviū" read as "Pelluvium"; "Transpicitur" read as printed; "Ovid." in Pellucidus entry read as printed.
